roles_doc: Per-platform role->tier baseline: tiers() on a DEFAULT-OPTIONS ImageConfig for every valid ROLE_CHOICES role x platform cell — NO adhoc options enabled; board/flavor/desktop-weight/GPU-driver left at builder defaults. essential is locked (base list + node k8s payload + installed SNAP_ROLE_BINS); essential+removable = the builder's default install set; available = the rest of the platform catalog. The UI layers option atoms client-side from adhoc_adds: an enabled option's atoms render LOCKED (as essential_floor treats them) but MUST still be emitted in packages_add unless the role tier already installs them — a worklist entry has no per-option wire channel, so packages_add is the only channel that installs an option's atoms.
